generation_edit_rule: For every new frame, reference the frozen character master and both neighboring key poses together. Prefer local image edit/inpaint; reject identity drift rather than using the drifted frame as the next source.
manual_landmarks: dominant hand or measured weapon grip

Walk_Front: F00 left-foot contact; body center stable; opposite arm swing
F01 passing pose; trailing hair/sash follows
F03 passing return; loop to F00; keep visible shoes on shared baseline
Attack_Front: F01 guard rise / raise weapon-side arm
F01_5 referenced mid-swing candidate between F01 and F02

v91_transition_reference_chain.new_cel: AS48 Attack_Front transition between key poses 01 and 02
